stem:
Aisha helps manage a village fish pond and a kitchen garden. The group debates how to keep these human-made ecosystems healthy while meeting food needs.

Which statements are correct?

statements.text: A fish pond can meet human needs and still support ecosystem health if it is well designed and managed with environment-friendly practices.
Any kitchen garden supports ecosystem health automatically, even if it pollutes soil and water, because it is a human-made ecosystem.
Practices that reduce pollution, protect soil health, and keep useful living variety help judge whether a managed ecosystem supports long-term farming.

teacher.key_rationale: Human-made ecosystems support health only when well managed for pollution, biodiversity, and soil. Statement 2 wrongly treats any human-made site as healthy. Keys are 1 and 3.
